svg.title: Editing a field in the table
svg.desc: An optimistic edit. The browser validates the patch and re-runs the attention rules with exactly the functions the server runs, so the row moves before the request is sent; the server's answer replaces it, and a refusal puts the kept entry back with the API's own message. Undo is the inverse patch through the same endpoint, which is why `ongoing set` can do everything this does.
